nodes.label: Placeholder Image (placeholder.svg)
nodes.description: 1200x1200 generic image placeholder: light grey (#EAEAEA) square with faint concentric circles, crossing horizontal/vertical/diagonal guide lines, and a centered 'image' pictogram (mountain/landscape icon). Static frontend asset served from public/, used as a fallback when real images are missing.
nodes.rationale: Neutral, brand-free fallback graphic so UI layouts render without broken images; typical scaffold asset from Vite/React UI templates.
